cipher.name: KeyboardRowShiftCipher
cipher.idea: A simple, highly intuitive keyboard-based substitution cipher. Each letter is replaced by the letter immediately to its right on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, wrapping around to the start of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is an alphabetic character, locate it on the standard QWERTY keyboard rows:
   - Row 1: qwertypoiu (modified to group standard letters: q->w, w->e, e->r, r->t, t->y, y->u, u->i, i->o, o->p, p->q)
   - Row 2: asdfghjkl (a->s, s->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l, l->a)
   - Row 3: zxcvbnm (z->x, x->c, c->v, v->b, b->n, n->m, m->z)
2. Replace the character with the one to its right in its respective row, wrapping around to the first letter of that row if it is the last letter.
3. Preserve the original case (uppercase maps to uppercase, lowercase to lowercase).
4. If the character is not a letter (digits, spaces, punctuation), leave it completely unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the ciphertext:
1. If it is an alphabetic character, locate it on the standard QWERTY keyboard rows:
   - Row 1: qwertypoiu (q<-w, w<-e, e<-r, r<-t, t<-y, y<-u, u<-i, i<-o, o<-p, p<-q)
   - Row 2: asdfghjkl (a<-s, s<-d, d<-f, f<-g, g<-h, h<-j, j<-k, k<-l, l<-a)
   - Row 3: zxcvbnm (z<-x, x<-c, c<-v, v<-b, b<-n, n<-m, m<-z)
2. Replace the character with the one to its left in its respective row, wrapping around to the last letter of that row if it is the first letter.
3. Preserve the original case.
4. If the character is not a letter, leave it completely unchanged.
